name: Radiance Distribution Approximation for Non-Homogeneous Lights
definition: A method to approximate radiance distribution on mesh triangles where emission direction varies across the surface, using clamped cosine lobes distributed over an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) of the intersection area projection.
summary: Radiance Distribution Approximation for Non-Homogeneous Lights uses clamped cosine lobes within an AABB to capture directional emission variation, differing from spherical harmonics by using a discrete lobe set for Light Propagation Volumes.
